items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: "With Foy getting away from me, she came away."

ctx.x: Well, I went, you know, over there in the back, went in the laboratory. She didn't know I know the people. Man, she came out about her card. So she said, Ms. Claiborne Williams said, Joseph, this ain't your card. This is Emma, Emma the bell girl. I looked at her and said, Emma. I said, I really don't like what you took and done. Well, I told her. I didn't want to make no disturb. I wasn't telling people in the house. I said, Emma, I don't think I like what you done. I said, I think you're wrong. So, I said, Emma,…
Yeah, that sounds right. You passing cards on, man. Do you think it's right? No. I don't think it's right. You understand what I mean? Now, I never know me that too.
